newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 24.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 24.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday:

* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 26.71 points to a record 8,088.36 as Wall Street cheered fresh remarks on the economy and interest rates by Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan.

* The Capital Market Supervisory Agency said it was still studying the proposed sale of Indocement's stake in Indofood to Singapore-based QAF Limited. Critics have labelled the proposed sale as capital flight amid the falling rupiah against the dollar.

* On Wednesday, the Jakarta composite index ended up 6.75 points, or 0.95 percent, at an intra-day high of 718.19 points as sentiment improved due to a less volatile rupiah and a strong rise on Wall Street on Tuesday, brokers said.
* On Thursday, the rupiah was traded at 2,610.00/20.00 at 0150 GMT against an opening of 2,575.00/85.00.
* Tin miner Timah after tin prices fell to a fresh two-and-half year low on the London Metal Exchange on Tuesday.
* Indofood and Indocement on continued debate over allegations that the Salim Group is allowing capital to leave the country.
* Pharmaceutical firm Darya Varia on news it expects to post poor first half results.
* Textile firm Panasia Filamen and Lippo General Insurance after modest debuts on Tuesday.
* Small-sized Bank Ficorinvest after an announcement that privately-owned securities firm Bhakti Investama bought a 14.53 percent stake, worth some 40 billion rupiah, in the bank.
* Alumunium firm Indal after recent sharp rises due to reports that it planned to form a joint venture firm.
